question: Which Indian musician’s autobiography is titled ‘Raga Mala’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravi Shankar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Raga Mala"** is the autobiography of renowned Indian classical musician **Ravi Shankar, released in 1997.**
 
• It is a limited edition publication by **Genesis Publications, **featuring a hand-bound design with an initial print run of 2,000 signed and numbered copies.
 
• Notably, **George Harrison **contributed the foreword and served as Shankar's editor for the book.
 
• Containing a curated selection of photographs and documents sourced from Shankar's personal archives, "Raga Mala" provides readers with an intimate glimpse into the musician's life and career.
 
• The idea for the autobiography arose in 1994, when Harrison persuaded Shankar to embark on the project as a means to commemorate his 75th birthday.
 
• Following extensive research, interviews, and writing, the book was published to widespread acclaim and success.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Ravi Shankar **was a celebrated Indian sitarist and composer, renowned for his virtuosity and mastery of North Indian classical music. Throughout the latter half of the 20th century, he gained global recognition as the foremost authority on this genre, exerting a profound influence on musicians both in India and around the world.
 
• **Vishwa Mohan Bhatt,** professionally known as V. M. Bhatt, is a distinguished Hindustani classical music instrumentalist renowned for his expertise in playing the Mohan veena.
 
• **Ustad Zakir Hussain**, born on March 9, 1951, is an eminent Indian tabla player, composer, percussionist, music producer, and film actor. He is the eldest son of the legendary tabla maestro Alla Rakha, and he himself has achieved immense acclaim for his contributions to the world of music.
